name: New articles get indexed
goal: A new blog article or language edition goes live on virev.ai every day and answers 200, and Google indexes each new one within 3 days. Every miss has a live fix job pushing changes; the older unindexed backlog, IndexNow and the ledger are detail lines. new_unindexed_3d also holds the problem that came back most in this chat: from 10-16 to 10-19 it missed 11 runs in a row, because Google's daily request limit ran out in nearly every indexing window (about 30 reports on 10 days) and no request went out for 32 h on 10-18 and 10-19 while the owner's Mac, which sends the Search Console requests through Aside, was offline. When it misses, check first when Google last took a request and whether the request window fired.

metrics.label: Days since a new article went live
Articles from the last 14 days still unindexed 3+ days after going live
Data sources that failed (sitemap, pages, Search Console)

onMiss: Every run works in auto-sns-agent's SEO program (apps/llm-wiki/content/sessions/2026/10/02/0040-virev-seo-agent/program), under its brief.md rules. Each missed metric gets one fix step under p56 with duty "d2/<metric key>" and a live job. days_since_new_article lands and promotes the next built article, or writes the next one from opportunities.md, one subagent per article. new_unindexed_3d finds why Google has not indexed each listed article and ships the fix. source_errors fixes the read this run, or goes to a "seo sources fix" step. Also run `seo indexnow --new` when the detail lists unsent URLs, and score each overdue ledger check. A step whose job is live (agent_observe.list_agents) gets the new numbers and flagged lines by message; a step with no live job gets one with await rlm.create_session(brief, name=...), and the step's job is set to it. Never start a second copy. Its brief names the metric, value and target and the pages, articles or commits in the detail, and asks for shipped changes. Never end a run with a missed metric and no live fix job. SEO crawl, indexing and performance fixes to live apps/search pages and the owner-approved tool pages land under c74 (owner yes 10-19); new apps/search features and design changes stay parked until the owner says the 5180 demo is good enough (c40). Nothing goes outside (c37), and prod promotes need no ask (c74). new_unindexed_3d has a known cause (p90, p98): Google crawls a new page only after a Search Console Request indexing, and the only signed-in session is sieun@virev.ai in the owner's Aside on his MacBook Pro, which the box copies through scripts/seo/gsc-box.mjs once the Mac answers (watcher sgu-mac-export, job second google user). The 10-18 and 10-19 batch ages out of the window on 11-02 and 11-03. Until 11-04, a miss whose only cause is that the Mac is offline gets no new root-cause job: message second google user and new pages indexing with the number instead. Never use the M1 Air, its Chrome cookies or keychain, or the owner's gmail login from any box. Never create a Google account or add a Search Console owner. The Indexing API is off limits for blog pages.
